mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_clinic_reservation (student_id, reservation_date, time_slot) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{date}, #{timeSlot})
mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.student_id AS studentId, st.student_name AS studentName, st.school AS school, st.grade_key AS gradeKey, r.time_slot AS timeSlot FROM erp_bookstore_clinic_reservation r JOIN erp_student st ON st.student_id = r.student_id WHERE r.reservation_date = #{date} ORDER BY r.time_slot ASC, st.student_name ASC
